# Brief: ENADE 2021, Ciência da Computação (bacharelado)

The exam has two discursive questions plus Q1–8 in Formação Geral, and three discursivas plus 27 objectives in Componente Específico (p. 1). Componente Específico is 75% of the grade. Its discursivas (D3–D5) are worth 15% and its objectives (Q9–35) 85% of that component (p. 1). I worked from the extracted text only and rendered no pages. Questions that depend on a figure are flagged, because I could not read the figure itself.

## Componente Específico: discursivas (D3–D5)

| Q | Topic | What is asked / knowledge needed | Calc/trace |
|---|---|---|---|
| **D3** (pp. 14–15) | **Lógica proposicional**: tautologia, satisfazibilidade, consequência lógica | Four items (2.5 pts each). The truth table for formulas 1–6 is given. Items: (a) is there any tautology among formulas 1–6; (b) is set P or Q satisfiable; (c) is set P or Q unsatisfiable; (d) is formula 6 (¬b→a) a logical consequence of Q. Needs the four definitions given in the text and the ability to read the table. | Reading and reasoning over a truth table, no code |
| **D4** (p. 16) | **Lógica digital / arquitetura**: somador completo de 1 bit (full adder) | Describe the truth table (inputs A, B, Cin; outputs S, Cout) and draw the logic circuit diagram. Needs the sum/carry Boolean expressions (XOR, AND, OR). 10 pts. | Construct a table and draw a circuit |
| **D5** (pp. 17–18) | **Estruturas de dados / algoritmos**: heap máximo, `heapify`/`buildHeap` (C code) | (a) Give the array `{2,5,8,13,21,1,3,34}` after `buildHeap(a,8)`. (b) Give the worst-case time of `heapify`, in O or Θ notation (O(log n)). Needs the heap property and the left/right index formulas. | **Yes**, manual code trace for (a) |

## Componente Específico: objetivas (Q9–35)

All of these are single-answer questions (A–E). Where the format is "I/II/III" assertions, the number of assertions is given.

| Q (page) | Format | Topic | What is asked / knowledge needed | Calc/trace |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **9** (p. 19) | Simple MC | **SO – escalonamento** | Match a scheduling algorithm to its environment (batch, interactive, real-time). Options are FILO, RMS, SJF, round-robin and priority scheduling (Tanenbaum). | No |
| **10** (p. 19) | Simple MC | **Estruturas de dados** (Java Collections) | Identify four structures from descriptions: deque, singly linked list, stack and queue. | No |
| **11** (p. 20) | 5 assertions (I–V) | **IA – deep learning** | Given a neural-network diagram, judge how more layers, convolutional nets, more neurons, more samples and recurrent nets affect accuracy and training time. | No (conceptual) |
| **12** (p. 21) | 4 assertions | **Legislação – LGPD** | Sensitive data, anonymized data, data-subject rights, and the role of the ANPD. | No |
| **13** (p. 22) | Simple MC | **Eng. de software – desenvolvimento iterativo e evolutivo** | Correct statement about iterations: fixed duration, partial executable systems used as a prototype, usability testing. | No |
| **14** (p. 23) | Asserção-razão | **Arquitetura – Von Neumann** | I: the architecture persists today. II: prefetching of instructions. Judge both and whether II justifies I. | No |
| **15** (p. 24) | 3 assertions | **Eng. de software – Scrum** | Roles of Scrum Master and Product Owner, and whether they have authority over the team. | No |
| **16** (p. 25) | Simple MC | **Lógica digital – álgebra booleana** | Write the Boolean expression for a combinational circuit with NOT/OR/AND gates and inputs X1–X3. Figure-based. | Light symbolic work (read the circuit) |
| **17** (p. 26–27) | Asserção-razão | **SO – seção crítica / exclusão mútua** | Mutual exclusion by disabling interrupts, and its efficiency on multiprocessors. Based on Tanenbaum's four conditions and a figure. | No |
| **18** (p. 27) | 4 assertions | **IA/ML – aprendizado supervisionado × não supervisionado** | Linear regression is supervised; error as the gap between desired and generated output; use of unsupervised learning for pattern recognition. | No |
| **19** (p. 28) | 4 assertions | **IHC / Eng. de requisitos – personas e cenários** | Purpose of personas and scenarios in requirements elicitation. | No |
| **20** (p. 29) | 3 assertions | **Algoritmos – busca linear × binária recursiva** (code in C) | `funcao1` is linear search and `funcao2` is recursive binary search. Judge the printed output (7 - 7), worst-case speed, and whether the strategy is iterative. | **Yes**, trace plus complexity |
| **21** (p. 30) | Simple MC | **Redes – dispositivos de interconexão por camada** | Repeater, hub, bridge/switch, router, transport gateway (Tanenbaum). Pick the correct statement. | No |
| **22** (p. 31) | Simple MC | **Banco de dados – mapeamento ER → relacional** | From a DER with PESSOA, PET and TIPO_PET and cardinalities (1,1)/(0,n)/(1,n), choose the right relational schema: foreign keys and 3NF-like design. Figure-based. | No (analysis of cardinalities) |
| **23** (p. 32) | Simple MC | **Estruturas de dados – árvore binária de busca** | Insert (27, 34, 40, 18, 23, 5, 25, 36, 10, 7, -2) in order. Check height and left/right counts, the pre-, in- and post-order traversals, and the node maximum for a given number of levels. | **Yes**, build the tree and trace |
| **24** (p. 33) | 4 assertions | **Segurança – criptografia** (WhatsApp) | Public-key authentication, initialization vector (IV) and replay attacks, AES as symmetric encryption, SHA-256 for integrity. | No |
| **25** (p. 34) | 4 assertions | **Computação em nuvem** (NIST) | SaaS, elasticity, community cloud, IaaS. | No |
| **26** (p. 35) | 3 assertions | **IHC – interfaces adaptativas** | Techniques by adaptation level (content, navigation, presentation). | No |
| **27** (p. 36) | Simple MC | **Estatística – distribuição normal** | Histogram of 20,000 servers with mean 171 and SD 10. Use the 68-95-99.7 rule to pick the correct probability for an interval. Histogram figure. | **Yes**, simple calculation |
| **28** (p. 36–37) | 4 assertions | **Arquitetura – pipeline de 5 estágios** | Bubbles from an instruction-fetch miss, instruction latency, split instruction/data caches, and BTB for branch prediction. | No |
| **29** (p. 38) | 4 assertions | **Processamento de imagens – morfologia matemática** | Erosion takes the minimum and dilation takes the maximum under the kernel. Judge statements I–IV. Contains images/examples (not read). | No |
| **30** (p. 39) | 4 assertions | **Compiladores** | Roles of the lexical, syntactic and semantic analyzers and of the optimization phase. | No |
| **31** (p. 40) | 4 assertions | **Teoria da computação – Máquina de Turing** | Even-length binary palindrome machine (input 110011). Tape content after 4 and 8 moves, whether it halts in an accepting state, and whether a pushdown automaton (PDA) accepts the same language. Diagram-based. | **Yes**, trace the TM |
| **32** (p. 41) | 4 assertions | **Algoritmos – quicksort** (pseudocode) | Stack space, stability, average complexity O(n log n), and first versus last element as pivot. | Analysis of pseudocode (conceptual) |
| **33** (p. 42) | Simple MC | **Programação lógica – Prolog** | Pick the correct rule `saoirmas(X,Y)` (sisters) from the facts `paide`, `maede` and `mulher`. | Light logical trace over the facts |
| **34** (p. 43) | Simple MC | **Grafos – Dijkstra** | Distance estimates after two iterations from source D, with -1 meaning infinity. Weighted graph figure. | **Yes**, trace |
| **35** (p. 43) | Simple MC | **Sistemas distribuídos** | Clocks, peer-to-peer failure, resource sharing, scalability, and transparency (Coulouris). | No |

## Formação Geral (pp. 2–13)

- **D1** (p. 2): discursive on art, culture and censorship, and artistic freedom under the 1988 Constitution. Asks for two educational actions.
- **D2** (p. 4): discursive on smart cities. (a) Contribution to sustainable development. (b) A proposal for urban intervention.
- **Q1** (p. 5): social mobility in Brazil (OECD) and inequality.
- **Q2** (pp. 6–7): asserção-razão on food waste (hortaliças) and visual standards. It has an image (Embrapa).
- **Q3** (p. 8): bicycles and cycle lanes, with I/II/III assertions. It has a cartoon.
- **Q4** (p. 9): asserção-razão on the Gig Economy and informal work.
- **Q5** (pp. 10–11): suicide among Indigenous children and adolescents, with four assertions. It has a map.
- **Q6** (p. 11): asserção-razão on Covid-19 and life expectancy of Black and Latino people in the US.
- **Q7** (p. 12): health information on the internet, with three assertions.
- **Q8** (p. 13): majoritarian versus consensual democracy, with four assertions.

## Frequency count of topics (Componente Específico)

There are 30 items: 27 objectives plus D3, D4 and D5.

- **Arquitetura de computadores / lógica digital: 5.** Q14 (Von Neumann), Q16 (circuit), Q28 (pipeline), D4 (full adder). I count D3 (propositional logic) under the logic/theory group below.
- **Algoritmos e estruturas de dados: 6.** Q10 (Java collections), Q20 (linear versus binary search), Q23 (ABB), Q32 (quicksort), Q34 (Dijkstra), D5 (heap).
- **Engenharia de software / IHC: 5.** Q13 (iterative development), Q15 (Scrum), Q19 (personas and scenarios), Q26 (adaptive interfaces). Q19 and Q26 are IHC, so software engineering proper has 2 and IHC has 2.
- **IA / aprendizado de máquina: 2.** Q11 (deep learning), Q18 (supervised/unsupervised).
- **Lógica / teoria / linguagens: 5.** D3 (propositional logic), Q30 (compilers), Q31 (Turing machine/PDA), Q33 (Prolog). Prolog and propositional logic also overlap with IA.
- **Sistemas operacionais: 2.** Q9 (scheduling), Q17 (critical section).
- **Redes, distribuídos e nuvem: 3.** Q21 (network devices), Q25 (cloud), Q35 (distributed systems).
- **Segurança e legislação: 2.** Q24 (cryptography), Q12 (LGPD).
- **Banco de dados: 1.** Q22 (ER to relational mapping).
- **Estatística / imagens: 2.** Q27 (normal distribution), Q29 (morphology).

Items that need real tracing or calculation are D3, D4, D5, Q16, Q20, Q23, Q27, Q31, Q33 and Q34. The 17-point cluster of conceptual "assertion" questions makes up most of the objective part. Not all counts are exclusive, because Q19 and Q26 sit between software engineering and IHC, and Prolog (Q33) overlaps with logic and IA.

Pages consulted: 1–44. Pages 45–48 were left unread. Their extracted text is very short (about 40–50 characters per page), so they appear to be blank or back-cover pages.
